content.text:
Swapped the conference logo.

- Copied the file to `assets/futureforgelogo-light.png` (526×193, white artwork on transparent — right for the dark deck).
- `index.html:16` now points at it, with `alt="FutureForge"`.
- `css/deck.css:138` — bumped `.hud-conf` height from `30px` → `46px`. The old NexusCon mark was a single line (4.6:1); this one is a two-line "nasscom / future forge" lockup (2.7:1), so at 30px each line would have rendered about half the previous text size. 46px keeps per-line size roughly matched to before.

No other references to the old logo anywhere. Two things I left alone:

- `assets/nexusconlogo.png` and `assets/nexusconlogo-light.png` are now unused (both untracked) — say the word and I'll delete them.
- The deck still says Bengaluru in several places (title slide `ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು · BENGALURU`, and the thank-you slide's `ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು, ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು!`) plus the whole Kannada talk track. If this conference isn't in Bengaluru, that copy needs updating too — let me know the city and I'll adjust.
On slide 4, the animation for the image on the left appears rather slowly. fix it

content.text:
Slide 4's terminal replay now runs in about half the time — roughly 8.5s → 4.5s end to end.

`index.html` (the `--t` line delays):
- Session 1: `400…6000ms` → `200…3000ms`, now an even 350ms per line instead of 600–800ms gaps.
- Session 2: `7600/8200` → `3900/4250`.

`css/deck.css`:
- `.ln` reveal duration `0.35s` → `0.28s` (line 381).
- Session-1 ghost-out: delay `6.4s` → `3.35s`, duration `1.2s` → `0.8s` (line 392) — fires right after the last commit line lands.
- Session-2 entrance: delay `6.9s` → `3.6s`, duration `0.9s` → `0.6s` (line 395).

The beat structure is intact — nine lines tick out, session 1 fades to a ghost, the empty session drops in — just tighter. If it's still lagging your delivery, the whole thing scales cleanly: halve the `--t` values again and pull the two delays to ~1.7s/1.8s.
